ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Child Care Funding Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of fraud in Minnesota's child care funding and the subsequent lawsuits against the Trump administration.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the administration of child care funding
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
Who was involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant pattern of corruption and mismanagement in the administration of child care funding.

ideas.title: ICE Shooting Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a civilian by an ICE agent in Minneapolis.
ideas.angle: Examine the use of force by law enforcement agencies and potential police brutality
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was the use of force justified?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the use of force by law enforcement agencies and potential police brutality.
